extracted.name: Guava Barbeque Sauce
extracted.description: Sweet guava and fiery scotch bonnet chile pepper are the signature flavors in this tropical-inspired barbeque sauce.
ingredient_lines: 0.25 scotch bonnet chile pepper (or to taste), minced
kosher salt and pepper to taste
instruction_lines: Place the water, guava paste, vinegar, rum, tomato paste, lemon juice, onion, ginger, soy sauce, ketchup, Worcestershire sauce, garlic, and scotch bonnet pepper into a saucepan. Bring to a simmer over medium-high heat, whisking until evenly blended. Season to taste with salt and pepper.

Reduce heat to medium-low and simmer until the sauce has slightly thickened and is richly flavored, 10 to 15 minutes. The sauce should be pourable. If it has become too thick, thin it with some water. Serve hot or cold.
